Stand: März 2026 
 
 
Semester dates  
Winter semester 26/27 28th September 2026 – 6th February 2027 
Spring semester 27 8th March 2027– 10th July 2027 
Nomination deadlines  
Winter semester April 30 
Spring semester October 31 
Application deadlines  
Winter semester May 15 (Non-EU-students) / May 31 (EU-students) 
Spring semester Nov. 15 (Non-EU-students) / Nov. 30 (EU-students) 
Orientation week 1 week before lectures start.  
Winter semester 26/27 21st September 2026 – 25th September 2026 
Spring semester 27 1st March 2027 – 5th March 2027 
Is a language course organised for Incoming 
Students? 
Yes, we offer courses based on the different 
language skills on the levels A1 – C1 
Approximate costs (in Euro)  
     Students’ Union 158,90 € (per semester) 
     Accommodation  
 
Once your accommodation is booked, no change will 
be possible. 
 
          Private flat (flat sharing) 
approx. from 300€ to 325€ (monthly) + 320 € deposit 
+300 € administration fee / rental contract always 
lasts for 4,5 months  
    Food ~ 300 € (monthly) 
     City transportation 
Deutschlandticket (63 € / month) which can be used 
for all suburban trains (2nd class), trams and busses 
throughout Germany 
    Leisure time 
100 – 200 € (monthly - depending on each student). 
An overview of the average cost of living for students 
in Germany can be found HERE. 
Mentor/Buddy program Student tutors will help incomings from their arrival 
throughout their semester abroad 
Other useful information or web sites for Incoming Students 
Nearest airport: 
Frankfurt/Main (35 min by train) –nearly each half an hour to Mannheim central station (ticket ~30 €), where a 
buddy will pick up the incoming student.
